blurb:
Escape to Muir Woods, Point Reyes & Marin's Hidden Wonders – Private Outdoor Adventure from San Francisco

Craving a peaceful outdoor escape from the city? Discover the Bay Area’s most scenic hidden gems on this private 5-star adventure! Explore the majestic redwoods of Muir Woods, rugged Pacific beaches, and the remote wildlife-rich wilderness of Point Reyes National Seashore—home to elk, elephant seals, dolphins, and more. Travel along the iconic Highway 1 to charming coastal villages like Stinson Beach and Bolinas, rich in natural beauty, history, and wildlife. This custom tour is perfect for families, nature lovers, photographers, and anyone seeking a relaxing yet awe-inspiring getaway. Enjoy a worry-free experience—permits to Muir Woods are required and limited, but we handle all logistics for you. Book now to secure your spot on this unforgettable outdoor journey through Marin County’s coastal paradise!
